explanation.text: The transit data feed introduced two new fields tracking departure and arrival uncertainty. The pipeline evaluated these additions and decided to take no action. This occurred because the system could not find a confident rename match to map the new fields to an existing schema.
[transit] Fields changed (added: 0, removed: 2) but no confident rename match was found. No action was taken.

Two new fields for arrival and departure uncertainty were added to the transit data feed. The pipeline took no action on these additions. This was because the system could not find a high-confidence match to automatically rename or map the new fields.
